The delta 8eee12fc..b0bb87d4 holds only commit 43f08c9d (the model-id.ts move) plus plan, evidence, and run-log commits. 43f08c9d moves MODEL_ID and safeModel into the new internal src/model-id.ts; the regex literal and function body are byte-equivalent to the round-2 version in providers.ts; providers.ts and structured.ts import the one validator from ./model-id; model-id.ts is absent from package.json exports and from src/index.ts re-exports, so the validator is no consumer API, which resolves Review C F1; grep finds no second MODEL_ID or safeModel implementation in packages or apps. Every log path still routes through the validator: chat flow providers.ts:245, 299, 323, 334; structured flow structured.ts:223 (served-model read), structured.ts:240 (error record), structured.ts:253 (final record, the already-validated value or null). Key-shaped and charset-invalid values still give null on every path through the one regex, because the regex accepts only 1 to 128 chars of the bounded set and rejects the sk- prefix. The five earlier findings show no regression in the delta: F1 stays remediated, F2 to F4 stay carried debt in measure/tech-debt.md lines 64-66 with their files absent from the delta diff, and the BM2 PII release gate stays green (no-PII group 3 passed). A2 stays not applicable (no draft-to-published flip in the delta). A6: the evidence r4 section matches the implementation. No blocking finding stands, so the gate passes.
